tools.name: handover.whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated person or service agent, organization, workspace, role, and granted scopes. Call this before reading or publishing to confirm attribution and tenancy.

tools.name: handover.search
tools.description: Find current shared context with hybrid, semantic, or lexical retrieval across metadata and artifact content. Use an empty query to list recent handovers.

tools.name: handover.get
tools.description: Read a handover snapshot, continuation brief, artifact metadata, and revision history. Omit revisionId for the current snapshot.

tools.name: handover.read_artifact
tools.description: Read bounded artifact content after inspecting a handover. Text is returned as UTF-8 and binary content as base64; truncated results report that explicitly.

tools.name: handover.thread
tools.description: Read comments, explicit mentions, assignments, and eligible collaborators without changing revision history.

tools.name: handover.annotations
tools.description: Read revision-anchored file comments, selected text, status, authorship, and resolution metadata. Use status=open to find feedback that still needs action.

tools.name: handover.create
tools.description: Create durable shared context with an initial immutable revision. Authorship comes from the authenticated Handover identity.

tools.name: handover.continue
tools.description: Append an immutable revision after reading the current snapshot. expectedRevisionId is mandatory to prevent overwriting another collaborator's work. Omitted artifacts are inherited; matching names are replaced.

tools.name: handover.comment
tools.description: Append a discussion comment and optionally notify explicitly mentioned collaborators.

tools.name: handover.annotate
tools.description: Add a durable comment anchored to selected text or lines in an immutable artifact revision. Read the artifact first and preserve the exact quote and surrounding context.

tools.name: handover.update_comment
tools.description: Edit an authored comment, or resolve/reopen an annotation. Set resolvedRevisionId when a new handover revision addressed the feedback.

tools.name: handover.assign
tools.description: Replace the open assignments with the supplied collaborator identities. This changes collaboration state, not the immutable handover revision.

tools.name: handover.publish
tools.description: Create or update a stable /r/{slug}/ report projection of a Handover revision.

tools.name: handover.publication
tools.description: Read the stable report URL, entry file, access mode, and selected revision for a handover.

tools.name: handover.pull
tools.description: Return the selected files of a published report with paths, hashes, media types, and UTF-8 or base64 content.

tools.name: handover.okf.export
tools.description: Export a handover revision as an Open Knowledge Format bundle for another human or agent system.

tools.name: handover.okf.import
tools.description: Import Open Knowledge Format files into a new immutable Handover revision. Replaying the same bundle is idempotent.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profile=core" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: handover.thread, handover.annotations, handover.annotate, handover.publication · Private data: handover.annotations, handover.publication, handover.pull, handover.okf.import · Public sink: handover.comment, handover.publish · Destructive: handover.okf.export, handover.okf.import.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: handover.thread, handover.annotations, handover.annotate, handover.publication · Private data: handover.annotations, handover.publication, handover.pull, handover.okf.import · Public sink: handover.comment, handover.publish · Destructive: handover.okf.export, handover.okf.import

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
